FROM node:10-alpine

RUN mkdir -p /home/node/app/node_modules && chown -R node:node /home/node/app

WORKDIR /home/node/app

COPY package*.json ./
USER root
RUN npm install -g nodemon
USER node

RUN npm install

COPY --chown=node:node . .

EXPOSE 8080

CMD [ "nodemon", "app.js" ]

{
  "name": "xxe_challenge",

  "description": "Sample XXE",

    "mongoose": "^5.9.17",
